---BASE---
# Local shared runtime defaults (git-ignored; not part of the checked-in repo).
# Populated to bring up a self-contained local runtime profile in this workspace.

SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=local-builder
SVA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000
SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=

# PII field encryption (application-level AES-256-GCM keyring)
IAM_PII_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=k1
IAM_PII_KEYRING_JSON={"k1":"iZ5dtL0U43SE43DoOiR3YjHGtd2y3bPF+t9i7MhUkFs="}

# Token-at-rest encryption key (base64 32-byte)
ENCRYPTION_KEY=<redacted-present>

# Local Postgres / IAM data layer
POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio
POSTGRES_USER=sva
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=<redacted-present>
APP_DB_USER=sva_app
APP_DB_PASSWORD=<redacted-present>
IAM_DATABASE_URL=postgres://sva_app:sva_app_local_dev_password@localhost:5432/sva_studio

# Local Redis
REDIS_PASSWORD=<redacted-present>
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379

# Waste database provisioner (compose secret for local infra)
WASTE_DATABASE_PROVISIONER_PASSWORD=<redacted-present>

# Mainserver is an external service not present in this workspace.
# Provide concrete (non-placeholder) values and mark the check optional.
SVA_MAINSERVER_GRAPHQL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9443/graphql
SVA_MAINSERVER_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9443/oauth/token
SVA_MAINSERVER_CLIENT_ID=studio-mainserver
SVA_MAINSERVER_CLIENT_SECRET=<redacted-present>
SVA_MAINSERVER_REQUIRED=false

# Keep the local runtime lean: no monitoring/OTEL collector in this workspace.
SVA_ENABLE_MONITORING=false

# Keycloak Admin API (required by the runtime profile contract; the local-builder
# mock profile does not perform OIDC logins, these values are not exercised in smoke).
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8081
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM=sva-studio
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-iam-service
KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=<redacted-present>

# Observability: no OTEL pipeline in this lightweight local workspace.
ENABLE_OTEL=false

# Pin the migrations dir to an absolute path so the app readiness check
# (which resolves it relative to the app server cwd) finds the checked-in
# Goose migrations regardless of where the dev server runs from.
MIGRATIONS_DIR=/workspace/packages/data/migrations

# Studio job worker (graphile) local provisioning:
# the worker pool connects as sva_job_worker; POSTGRES_HOST points at the
# locally exposed postgres (host network), mirroring the container-name used
# in swarm/CI runs.
STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER=sva_job_worker

observation.command: cd /workspace && ls -la config/runtime/ && echo '---BASE---' && cat config/runtime/base.vars 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\(PASSWORD\|SECRET\|KEY\|TOKEN\)=.*/\1=<redacted-present>/' | head -60
